newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen opening mixed to slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen opening mixed to slightly lower.

text.p: Wall Street is expected to open mixed to a bit lower on Monday amid profit-taking following last week's record rise, analysts said.

With no economic data out Monday, investors are expected to focus on company earnings. Before the market opened Dow industrials component AT&T Corp reported a first quarter earnings per operating share of $0.69, same as a First Call consensus estimate.
